description: This file is a shell script (.sh) containing tests for git fetch and pull commands with --set-upstream/--set-upstream options, including setup, configuration checks, and various test cases.

methods.name: check_config
methods.description: Checks whether the git config for branch remote and merge is set correctly for a given branch name.

methods.name: check_config_missing
methods.description: Verifies if the git config for branch remote and merge are missing for a given branch.

methods.name: clear_config
methods.description: Removes remote and merge configuration for provided branch names.

methods.name: ensure_fresh_upstream
methods.description: Initializes a fresh bare upstream repository.
